tasks.subject: Fix bobbybookmarks deployment errors (SQLite3 & Gunicorn)
tasks.description:
Investigate and fix deployment errors for 'bobbybookmarks'. 
1. Node.js error: 'Could not locate the bindings file' for sqlite3 in 'bobbybookmarks-ui/server'. This usually indicates a missing native build or incorrect platform binary.
2. Python error: 'AttributeError: module app has no attribute application' in gunicorn. This indicates a mismatch between the gunicorn command and the actual Flask/Django app instance name.
I need to check the project structure, build scripts, and entry point files.
